texts.preamble: Tarab Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 27 March, 2025 Author: Sanjeev S Kalgaonkar Bench: Sanjeev S Kalgaonkar 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Crr No. 750 of 2014 (Tarab Khan Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And O Dated : 27-03-2025
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner - Tarab Khan submits that during the pendency of the present revision, the petitioner has moved an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail. Learned counsel further submits that revision petitioner desires to visit Mecca, Saudi Arabia, for pilgrimage (Umrah). Though the petitioner has filed an application for issuance of passport, but the Passport Authority has kept the application of petitioner on hold on the ground that petitioner is first required to seek necessary permission from this Court as per the notification dated 25.08.1993 issued by the Ministry of External Affairs. Hence, necessary permission be granted in the light of notification dated 25.08.1993 for obtaining/issuance of passport to the petitioner for a period of one year in the interest of justice. Learned counsel for respondent/State has opposes the prayer for grant of permission for issuance of passport to the petitioner in view of pendency of the present criminal revision.
